name: zentao-legacy-mcp
description: Cross-client MCP server for ZenTao (禅道) legacy session-based API (biz 4.x) — 86 tools: products/stories/bugs/tasks/builds/cases, rich-text images auto-upload, attachments, first-run deployment discovery.
prepack: npm run build && npm run build:standalone

scripts.build:standalone: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node18 --outfile=dist/standalone/zentao-legacy-mcp.cjs && chmod +x dist/standalone/zentao-legacy-mcp.cjs && echo standalone built
